'''Carshotta''' was a [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who performed in [[Preigo's Traveling World of Wonder/Legends|Preigo's Traveling World of Wonder]] carnival act. She and another Togruta performed an act involving [[Convor/Legends|Convorees]]. The two performers wore [[Color/Legends|colorful]] skin-tight outfits with loose bits of flowing transparent cloth.

While on [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]], the traveling circus went to [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka's]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Hondo's complex/Legends|stronghold]] and picked up the young [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiates]] [[Katooni/Legends|Katooni]], [[Petro/Legends|Petro]], [[Byph/Legends|Byph]], [[Gungi/Legends|Gungi]], and [[Zatt/Legends|Zatt]] on the way.

After the young [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] initiates rescued [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], Ohnaka's [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|pirate gang]] attacked them, forcing the carnival to retreat. Carshotta was seen also escaping aboard [[Preigo/Legends|Preigo's]] [[Starship/Legends|ship]].
